connector.name: DBeast PostgreSQL MCP
connector.registryDescription: PostgreSQL MCP server for schema, query, health, security, and performance analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image dbeast:2.0.2. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the snss10 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
